diagnosis.renderDownload: The result video downloaded and was retained. The later render download was rejected by the shared commercial release gate because cp73 was release-ineligible; this is expected fail-closed behavior, not an authentication or storage failure.
diagnosis.redoGap: The existing merge contract required at least one preserved shot, making a bounded all-shot redo impossible for a one-shot candidate where every shot failed. Workbench planning already produced an empty preserved set correctly.

implementation.allShotRedo: preservedShots may be empty only when selected redo shotIds exactly partition the entire composition storyboard
implementation.fullRequalification: the regenerated shot is recomposed into a new complete render and both shot and final perceptual policies are evaluated again
implementation.failClosed: partial coverage with an empty preserved set is rejected before any provider submission
implementation.runner: rejected renders are no longer downloaded as ordinary evidence; their bytes remain durable while the release gate stays closed
